Run: npm --prefix ./functions run build && node -e "require('./functions/lib/index.js')" && FUNCTIONS_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT=120 npm run firebase deploy -- --only functions, then read cold-start logs for MODULE_NOT_FOUND. A deployed HTTPS fn returning 401 is HEALTHY (module loaded, auth gate ran); 500 means it failed to load. If it fails, the documented fallback is browser-only rendering — cheap BECAUSE the codec seam exists.

knownTrap_functionsNodeModules: 🛑 MEASURED 2026-10-18. Installing functions/node_modules (needed only to get tsup for `npm --prefix ./functions run build`) takes the Stop hook from 22 SECONDS to a 10-MINUTE TIMEOUT. Some audit walks functions/ without excluding node_modules; it is gitignored so nothing catches it. Workaround in place: the directory is renamed to functions/node_modules_parked. Rename it back to build the bundle, then park it again — or better, FIND the audit and add the exclusion, since the next person to run `npm install` in functions/ silently loses their whole audit gate. Candidates: any audit walking functions/ (ssr-in-appkit, use-client, catch-normalize all do directory walks).
